summary: Address code smell: Shotgun Surgery: fh locals in vdisplay portal input

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm Shotgun Surgery smell for the variable 'fh' in src/koru/integrations/vdisplay/portal_input.py (planfile ticket PLF-058, reported at line 403) by replacing the generic local with a stage-accurate name in each of the seven functions that assigned it: guard_h (_focus_ring_appeared, the height of the decoded before/after RGB array that scales the stream-space target into frame pixels and clamps the focus-guard's blue-sampling window), frame_rows (_blue_ring_center, the decoded frame's row count sizing the blue-row bincount histogram that locates the lowest wide ring band), calib_h (calibrate_input_from_focus, the calibration frame's height mapping the detected ring center into stream coords), panel_h (_pending_action_present, the frame height gating a 'backspace' OCR box into the chat-panel region above the terminal strip), anchor_h (_stream_target_from_ocr, the frame height mapping the OCR anchor - placeholder or landmark fallback - into stream coords), precise_h (_precise_stream_xy, the frame height mapping the precise placeholder anchor into stream coords, pairing with the existing precise_fx local), and reanchor_h (_clear_and_reanchor_stream_xy, the frame height mapping the post-clear re-anchor position into stream coords). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'fh' group drops from 7 scopes to 0 and the file mutation record count is unchanged at 201 (pure rename). Each new name lands at exactly 1 scope. The 'fw' group (6 scopes) keeps its generic name in this lane - it is a separate open planfile ticket with its own dedupe key - as are the already-distinct 'aw'/'ah' (_focused_near) and 'fw0'/'fh0' (_maybe_autoremember_focused_input) pairs, which are different variable names and were never counted. Pure rename: no signature, return shape, env var or behavior change; no other file touched. No duplication.toon.yaml exists in this repository, so the duplication-report checklist has nothing to consult for the touched path.
nonGoals: No behavior, coordinate-math, gating-threshold or interface change
No rename of 'fw' - it is a separate open planfile ticket (dedupe key code2llm:smell:shotgun_surgery:src/koru/integrations/vdisplay/portal_input.py:403:Shotgun Surgery: fw) and keeps its own lane

No new shared frame-geometry helper; the seven heights sit at distinct stages (focus-guard window scaling, ring-row histogram, calibration mapping, panel-region gating, OCR anchor mapping, precise-anchor mapping, post-clear re-anchor mapping) and a forced abstraction would couple independent coordinate stages
No rename of the keyword arguments frame_w=/frame_h= accepted by frame_to_stream (call-site arguments, not locals, and part of the portal session contract)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local naming only, inside one module. Every function that bound the generic name 'fh' now names exactly the coordinate stage it consumes: the focus-diff guard names its sampling-window frame height (guard_h), the ring locator names its histogram row count (frame_rows), calibration names its mapping height (calib_h), the pending-action detector names its panel-region bound (panel_h), the OCR anchor mapper names its anchor mapping height (anchor_h), the precise-anchor mapper names its precise mapping height (precise_h), and the two-pass clear names its post-clear re-anchor mapping height (reanchor_h). The generic name 'fh' disappears from the file's assignment set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports an 'fh' mutation group of exactly 7 scopes - _focus_ring_appeared, _blue_ring_center, calibrate_input_from_focus, _pending_action_present, _stream_target_from_ocr, _precise_stream_xy, _clear_and_reanchor_stream_xy - matching the ticket's 'spans 7 functions'; after the rename the 'fh' group is empty, the file mutation record count is unchanged at 201 (pure rename), and every new name lands at exactly 1 scope. The 'fw' group stays at 6 scopes (own open ticket); no other group reaches the >= 5 threshold.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named fh again and the smell report returns.

Baseline content reports an 'fh' mutation group of 7 scopes (_focus_ring_appeared, _blue_ring_center, calibrate_input_from_focus, _pending_action_present, _stream_target_from_ocr, _precise_stream_xy, _clear_and_reanchor_stream_xy) - exactly matching the ticket's reported 'spans 7 functions'; renamed content reports an 'fh' group of 0 scopes; file mutation record count unchanged at 201 (pure rename); each new local (guard_h, frame_rows, calib_h, panel_h, anchor_h, precise_h, reanchor_h) lands at exactly 1 scope, far below the >= 5 threshold; the untouched 'fw' group stays at 6 scopes for its own open ticket.

The suites that exercise the renamed frame-geometry paths (portal input unit tests including the two-pass clear flow, the vdisplay coordinate contract, the autonomous vdisplay defaults and the module split) pass unchanged - pure rename of function-internal locals - and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
